entries.title: Separation
entries.lead: Accounts set up for a shared life can outlast it. Toza finds, with you and in person, what still connects you.

entries.title: Business dispute
entries.lead: A personal email may still recover a business account. Toza helps you find where personal and business access meet, and separate them deliberately.

entries.title: Inheritance conflict
entries.lead: Help with an account, years ago, may still connect someone to your correspondence. Toza works through it with you, in person.
